title: useEffect syncing open-state creates new object every time grouped changes — triggers re-render cascade
detail: Lines 49-55: useEffect watches [grouped] and calls setOpen(next) unconditionally, creating a new open-state object. Because grouped recalculates on every page/filter change, this fires on every page turn, triggering a full re-render of all customer group headers.
evidence: ViewCustomerGroups.jsx:49-55 — useEffect([grouped]) sets new open state object unconditionally.
recommendedFix: Use functional update: setOpen(prev => { var next = {...prev}; grouped.forEach(g => { if (next[g.id] === undefined) next[g.id] = true; }); return next; }).

title: Pagination uses arrow characters and different styling than ViewSmartList pagination
detail: Lines 128-139: ViewCustomerGroups uses arrow chars and opacity-based disabled styling, while ViewSmartList uses text labels and color-based disabled styling. Inconsistent within the same contracts section.
recommendedFix: Extract a shared Pagination component. Low priority cosmetic issue.
